captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a flat, parametric knife sheath with a curved tip. It features a straight spine and a curved bottom edge that tapers to a rounded point, mirroring the profile of a knife blade. On one side, there is an L-shaped cutout window that exposes the interior cavity, allowing the user to view the blade shape inside.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric knife sheath in OpenSCAD that accommodates customizable blade dimensions. The design should include adjustable parameters for knife length, maximum blade width, blade thickness, and an optional visual cutout window to reveal the blade profile.
captions.factory: The design utilizes a custom 'blade' module which constructs the blade shape by intersecting a rectangular cube with a rotated cylinder to form the curved tip, then unioning it with a straight rectangular section. The main 'parasheath' module uses a boolean difference operation to subtract an inner blade-shaped cavity (with added padding) from an outer, oversized blade-shaped solid. An optional rectangular cube is translated and subtracted to create the L-shaped visual cutout window on the side of the sheath.
